## About
Brian's Lawnmower is a family operated shop on Manalapan Road in Spotswood. Brian Engstrom is the owner and operator, and Sue Engstrom is our office manager.
We service push mowers, edgers, rototillers, snowblowers, power washers, Echo and Redmax products, and generators. Our focus is quality repairs and reasonable prices.
We're rated 4.6 from 94 reviews on Google. One customer who has come to Brian for several years wrote that he has never let him down.

## Services
- Small Mowers: Service and repair on small mowers. ($69.99 + parts)
- Powerwashers: Service and repair on power washers. ($69.99 + parts)
- Generators: Service and repair on generators. ($109.99 + parts)
- Edgers: Service and repair on edgers. ($59.99 + parts)
- Snowblowers: Snowblower service, available November through March.
- Blade (off machine): Blade sharpening when you bring the blade in off the machine. ($8.00)
- Echo and Redmax two stroke products: We service Echo and Redmax two stroke equipment.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: No. Just drop off your equipment during business hours.

Q: Is there a deposit for repairs?
A: Yes. As of 7/1/24 a $40 deposit is required for all equipment dropped off for repair.

Q: How can I pay?
A: We are cash only on parts and repairs.

Q: When do you service snowblowers?
A: Snowblowers are only serviced November through March.

Q: What if I decide not to go ahead with the repair?
A: There is a $30.00 estimate fee if work is not completed.
